Advanced Abrasive Solutions for Precision Grinding # Diamond and CBN grinding wheels are essential tools for achieving high-precision results when working with extremely hard materials. Their versatility and durability make them indispensable in a variety of industries, from manufacturing to aerospace and medical device production.
What Are Diamond & CBN Grinding Wheels Used For? # Diamond grinding wheels and CBN (Cubic Boron Nitride) grinding wheels are engineered for grinding and shaping materials that are exceptionally hard, such as carbide cutting tips, gemstones, and concrete. These wheels are available in multiple shapes, including flat disks, cups, cylinders, cones, and custom profiles to suit specific grinding needs.
The selection of grit size for these wheels depends on the hardness and characteristics of the material being processed. This allows users to tailor the grinding process for optimal performance and finish quality.
Key Applications # Carbide and Steel Processing: Diamond wheels are typically used for grinding carbide materials, while CBN wheels are preferred for steel due to their respective material compatibilities and extended service life. Medical and Dental Manufacturing: Both diamond and CBN wheels are utilized in the production of ceramic and metallic components for medical and dental devices, where precision and surface finish are critical. Automotive and Aerospace Components: These wheels are instrumental in finishing ceramic automotive parts and grinding aerospace components that require extremely tight tolerances and high reliability. Customization and Quality # Best Diamond Ind. Co., Ltd. offers customization services to deliver high-quality diamond and CBN grinding wheels tailored to specific requirements. For more information or to explore additional diamond tool solutions, contact us or browse our full product range.
Types of Diamond & CBN Grinding Wheels # Electroplated Diamond & CBN wheels Resinoid Diamond & CBN Wheels Metal Bond Diamond & CBN Wheels Vitrified Diamond & CBN Wheels Hybrid Diamond & CBN Grinding Wheels Each wheel type is designed for specific grinding processes and material requirements, ensuring the right solution for every application.

Unveiling the Versatility of Diamond and CBN Tools # Diamond, renowned as the hardest abrasive available today, stands out for its exceptional hardness and wear resistance. These properties make diamond tools indispensable for grinding nonferrous materials, especially those that are particularly hard and dense. In contrast, Cubic Boron Nitride (CBN) serves as a bridge between conventional abrasives and diamond, excelling in the grinding of hard-to-grind ferrous materials where traditional abrasives such as aluminum oxide or silicon carbide fall short.
Product Categories # A broad spectrum of diamond and CBN tools is available to meet various industrial requirements:
Diamond & CBN Mounted Points Diamond Hand Files Diamond Machine Files Plated Diamond Mandrel Discs Diamond Polishing Stones Diamond Compound (Paste) Diamond Micron Powders Diamond Foils & Cloth Diamond Dressing Tools Electroplated Diamond Core Drills Electroplated Diamond Cutters Diamond & CBN Grinding Wheels PCD & PCBN Turning Tools Applications and Types # These tools are engineered for a variety of applications, including:
General Purpose Grinding Internal Grinding Precision Hand Filing Machine Filing Polishing and Finishing Dressing and Truing of Grinding Wheels Turning and Drilling Operations Diamond and CBN tools are available in multiple forms, such as electroplated, resinoid bond, metal bond, and vitrified bond, to suit specific operational needs. Specialized dressers, including single point, multi-point, chisel type, coned, CVD diamond, and impregnated diamond dressers, are also offered for maintaining grinding wheel performance.

Enhanced Performance: CBN tools are ideal for ferrous materials that challenge conventional abrasives. Versatility: A wide range of tool types and bonds ensures compatibility with diverse industrial processes. Company Evolution and Key Achievements # Best Diamond Industrial Co., Ltd. has steadily advanced in the field of diamond and CBN tools since its inception. Below is a chronological summary of significant milestones that have shaped the company’s growth and reputation in the industry.
Timeline of Major Events # 1980: Best Diamond Ind. Co., Ltd. was founded in Hsin Chuang, Taiwan. The company began by producing electroplated diamond grinding wheels.
1985: Expanded its product line to include Diamond Dressers, Diamond Compounds, Diamond Files, and Diamond Mounted Points. A new manufacturing facility was established at Wu Ku Hsiang, near Taipei City.
1986: Initiated production of PCD (Polycrystalline Diamond) and PCBN (Polycrystalline Cubic Boron Nitride) turning tools. The company also began expanding sales into the Japanese market.
1988: Constructed a modern plant in Nan Kang, strategically located near CKS Airport to enhance logistics and production capabilities.
1989: Commenced manufacturing of metal bonded diamond tools, further diversifying the product range.
1992: Started producing resin bonded diamond and CBN grinding wheels. Entered the market for Pneumatic Grinding Machines.
1994: Launched a 10-year business plan focused on strengthening research and development for advanced diamond and CBN tools. The plan emphasized designing both generic and custom tools for mould and die lapping and polishing, maintaining high product quality with competitive pricing, and enhancing sales service. The company became the agent for “Gous” Ultra-sonic lapping machines and GP-series Pneumatic Grinding machines, and acquired a new office-warehouse complex to better serve customer needs.
1998: Added Ceramic Super Stones and Pneumatic Lapping Tools to the product portfolio, broadening the solutions offered to customers.
1999: Expanded export operations, reaching customers in more than 30 countries worldwide.
2000: Recognized as one of Taiwan’s key producers and suppliers of grinding and lapping tools, solidifying its position in the industry.

鑽石與氮化硼砂輪是現代精密加工中不可或缺的工具，適用於各種高硬度材料的研磨與切削。根據不同的應用需求與工藝條件，可選擇不同結合劑與製程的砂輪，以達到最佳加工效果。
以下為主要類型：
電鑄法鑽石與氮化硼砂輪 樹脂法鑽石與氮化硼砂輪 金屬法鑽石與氮化硼砂輪 陶瓷法鑽石與氮化硼砂輪 複合式鑽石與氮化硼砂輪 產品特色與應用
電鑄法砂輪：適合高精度加工，具有良好的形狀保持性。 樹脂法砂輪：研磨效率高，適用於多種材料的精細加工。 金屬法砂輪：耐磨性佳，適合長時間連續作業。 陶瓷法砂輪：結構穩定，適合高溫及高負載環境。 複合式砂輪：結合多種結合劑優點，滿足特殊加工需求。 依據不同產業與加工條件，選擇合適的砂輪類型，能有效提升加工品質與效率。如需更多產品資訊，歡迎進一步瀏覽各產品頁面。
